jobs.description:
The Beauty Plug is an intimate skincare studio located in Studio City. I am a solo esthetician looking for a highly organized, customer service driven individual to support the daily operations and client experience of the studio.

This role is **not treatment focused**. The priority is client coordination, communication, organization, and studio readiness. Esthetic training and growth into the treatment room is optional and can happen over time for the right person.

I am looking for someone who takes pride in creating a seamless, elevated client experience and can run the front end of the business confidently and independently.

This role is ideal for someone who

* Is extremely strong in customer service and follow up
* Is organized, detail oriented, and proactive
* Is comfortable being the first person in the studio
* Enjoys managing systems, schedules, and communication
* Is friendly, professional, and confident with clients
* Is tech savvy and comfortable with email, CRM systems, and social media

Core Responsibilities

* Opening the studio and ensuring it is clean, stocked, and client ready
* Confirming appointments and sending pre visit instructions
* Ensuring clients complete intake and request forms
* Confirming memberships and retail history prior to visits
* Client follow ups after treatments and product purchases
* Weekly check ins with retail clients
* Email communication and follow up sequences
* Managing inventory, supplies, and water refresh
* Client parking instructions and arrival communication

Requirements

* Strong background in receptionist, client coordination, or customer service
* Excellent communication skills written and verbal
* Must have reliable transportation
* Must have their own laptop
* Experience in the beauty or wellness industry is a plus but not required

Growth Opportunity

For candidates who are licensed estheticians or currently in school, there is an opportunity to receive hands on training and eventually move into the treatment room once systems and client flow are fully supported.

**Contract Type:** Independent Contractor (1099\) — Project\-Based Engagement

**Project Duration:** 100 Days

**Compensation:** $4,000 – $8,000 for the full project term, determined by experience and deliverable performance

**Schedule:** Fully flexible and self\-directed. No assigned hours. The contractor determines their own work schedule and methods, provided all project deliverables are completed within the contract term.

**Location:** On\-site at Wellcare PAL facility, East Los Angeles, CA

* Greet and direct visitors, vendors, drivers, and business contacts arriving at the facility.

* Support fleet dispatch operations by managing bus scheduling and assignment logistics as needed during the project term.
* Maintain comprehensive records of all procurement activity, fleet service requests, deliveries, and operational data throughout the engagement.
* Ensure facility cleanliness and maintenance standards are upheld, conducting site assessments and initiating corrective actions as needed.
* Execute ad\-hoc operational project tasks across departments as assigned, within the defined scope of this engagement.

**CONTRACTOR QUALIFICATIONS**

* Prior experience in a front desk, receptionist, office coordinator, or administrative support role preferred.
* Comfortable managing a multi\-task office environment independently with minimal supervision.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly in record\-keeping, invoicing, and inventory management.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with vendors, mechanics, and operational staff.
* Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and perform active, on\-site inspections and facility walkthroughs.
* Reliable transportation to the East Los Angeles project site is required.

**INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR NOTICE**

This is a project\-based independent contractor engagement. The selected individual will be classified as a 1099 independent contractor and will retain full control over the manner, means, and schedule by which project deliverables are completed. This engagement does not establish an employment relationship with Wellcare PAL, and the contractor will be solely responsible for all applicable tax obligations. Wellcare PAL does not provide benefits, workers’ compensation, or withholding under this engagement.

Pay: $1,333\.00 \- $2,667\.00 per month

* Flexible schedule

* Los Angeles, CA 90022 (Required)

OMG Accessories is the iconic fashion brand behind millions of stylish kids and tweens around the world. We’ve dreamed up a unique blend of big ideas, timeless inspiration, and sprinkled it with plenty of sparkle and shine, for the ultimate mini fashionista. Our whimsical designs and products are custom\-made by our talented team, from each and every detail, to inventing our own fabrications and charm.

· Assist with communicating accurate \& precise packing specifications for each production order to our overseas manufacturers

· Assist w/ uploading required production info \& details to A2000 {ERP System}

jobs.title: Claris Enterprise Field Sales Representative
jobs.description:
The people at Claris don't just build software \- they build the infrastructure layer that makes Apple's AI story real in schools, enterprises, and government organizations. As part of the Enterprise Sales team within the Claris division, you'll work at the intersection of Apple's education and enterprise sales motion and one of the most consequential technology shifts in a generation: the move to AI\-ready infrastructure.  

  

Claris' Data Analytics and AI clustering platforms add a compelling component to Apple's strong story around AI, privacy, and security. We open new rooms, introduce new decision\-makers, and help organizations understand what AI\- ready infrastructure actually looks like in practice.  

  

**Description**  

  

Work alongside Apple's education and enterprise sales teams in the field \- co\- selling, co\-presenting, and helping qualify strategic accounts across K\-12 districts, higher education institutions, enterprises, and government organizations. You will position the Claris' emerging AI tools in the context of each customer's business, infrastructure, and AI ambitions.  

  

Generate, qualify, and develop pipeline across all three Claris AI revenue streams \- Pulse Cloud, Pulse On\-Prem, and AI cluster licensing \- and ensure that the leads you originate and qualify are developed with full context, a clear use case, and a warm relationship already established such that they can be carried to completion or handed off to Inside Sales teams.  

  

Represent Claris at Apple's global Executive Briefing Centers (EBCs) and conferences, delivering or supporting persona\-specific demo narratives for incoming customer profiles. Show up at Apple\-led one\-to\-many field events and qualify from the audience.  

  

Help identify and engage organizations with executive AI vision and existing Apple silicon. Keep them engaged through the discovery process.  

  

Convert pipeline generated through association partnerships into qualified accounts. These leads are time\-sensitive; follow\-up must be fast.  

  

Log every meeting and customer interaction in the Claris CRM.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

Exceptional storyteller: You excel at presenting to diverse audiences, staying cool under pressure, and making complex concepts simple and engaging.  

  

Deep ecosystem knowledge: You understand how our hardware, software, and services integrate, and you're passionate about sharing the Apple story and helping others learn.  

  

Strategic business acumen: You are genuinely curious about how organizations operate, with a solid grasp of budget cycles, IT constraints, and AI ambitions.  

  

Consultative sales style: You know that the best sales conversations start with listening, using curiosity to qualify opportunities effectively rather than just pushing a pitch.  

  

Executive presence: You are comfortable and confident leading strategic conversations with senior decision\-makers, including CIOs, Superintendents, and VPs of IT.  

  

Brand evangelist: You are confident introducing Claris to leaders who may not yet be familiar with the brand.  

  

Value\-driven mindset: You are motivated by building meaningful, long\-term solutions rather than just chasing the fastest opportunities in the funnel.  

  

Partnership focus: You understand (or are eager to learn) Apple’s sales motion, viewing our partnerships as co\-selling relationships that require care, consistency, and mutual value.  

  

Familiarity with any of the following is a strong plus: K\-12 or higher education technology, Enterprise IT procurement cycles, Government technology purchasing.  

  

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

7\+ minimum years experience in business development, enterprise account management, or strategic sales \- ideally in a pre\-category or market\-creation environment  

  

An entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable working in a startup\-like atmosphere on a small team  

  

Demonstrated ability to work without an established playbook \- you build the motion as you go  

  

Consultative approach to customer engagement; you ask more than you pitch  

  

Experience working within or alongside a channel partner model  

  

Strong written and verbal communication \- you can debrief clearly, document accurately, and present confidently  

  

Ability to travel regularly for customer meetings, conferences, EBC appearances, and field events (up to 50% domestic travel)  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $139,300 and $209,700, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  

  

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.description:
**FullTerra / Clean Vapor**
===========================


**Assistant Project Manager**
-----------------------------


**Location:** Atlanta, GA, with travel to job sites throughout the Atlanta metro area


**Job Type:** Full\-Time, Exempt


### **Build Your Career in Environmental Construction**



Clean Vapor, a FullTerra company, is a specialty contractor providing vapor intrusion mitigation installation services for commercial and residential properties throughout the Atlanta market.



We are looking for an **Assistant Project Manager** to support the planning, coordination, and execution of vapor intrusion mitigation projects. You will work closely with Project Managers, field crews, subcontractors, clients, and trade partners to help ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, and according to project requirements.



This is an excellent opportunity for someone with construction or environmental project experience who wants to grow into a Project Manager role within a specialized area of the environmental construction industry.


### **What You'll Do**


**Project Coordination**


* Assist Project Managers with the day\-to\-day coordination of vapor intrusion mitigation installations, including sub\-slab depressurization systems, vapor barriers, and sub\-membrane venting
* Coordinate field crews, subcontractors, equipment, and material deliveries
* Help keep multiple active projects organized and on schedule
* Participate in client meetings and provide project progress updates
* Serve as an on\-site point of contact for subcontractors and trade partners during installation


**Plans, Documentation \& Compliance**


* Review site plans, system layouts, specifications, and approved designs
* Help verify installations are completed according to project requirements and applicable standards
* Maintain project documentation, including submittals, RFIs, punch lists, photo logs, and closeout packages
* Assist with permitting, site access agreements, and coordination with property owners and facility managers
* Support OSHA requirements and site\-specific health and safety plans


**Budgeting \& Estimating**


* Track project budgets, change orders, and daily field reports
* Identify and communicate potential scope or cost deviations to the Project Manager
* Prepare quantity takeoffs and assist with estimating for future projects as needed

### **What You Bring**


**Required Qualifications**


* 1\-3\+ years of experience in construction project coordination, environmental remediation, or a related field
* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Environmental Science, Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple active projects
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel and Outlook
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel to job sites throughout the Atlanta metro area
* OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification, or willingness to obtain certification within 90 days of hire


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with vapor intrusion or vapor mitigation projects
* Knowledge of vapor intrusion mitigation systems and methods, including sub\-slab depressurization, vapor barriers, and sub\-membrane depressurization
* Familiarity with ASTM E2121 and applicable state or EPA vapor intrusion guidance
* Experience using Bluebeam, Procore, Microsoft Project, or similar construction/project management software

* Ability to visit and work around active construction and installation sites
* Ability to access areas such as residential crawlspaces, commercial slabs, mechanical spaces, and below\-grade areas while using appropriate PPE

* Ability to lift approximately 25\-40 lbs
* Ability to stand or walk for extended periods during site visits

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance

* Paid vacation and paid holidays
* Vehicle/mileage allowance for travel between job sites
* Professional development support
* Opportunity to grow into a full Project Manager role

If you're an organized, detail\-oriented construction or environmental professional looking to develop your project management career, we'd like to hear from you.

Location: Chicago, IL  
Company: Evolve

Are you looking to break into marketing and events but don’t know where to start?

Evolv is currently hiring a Junior Marketing Assistant (Events) to join our Chicago team. This role is perfect for someone who enjoys working with people, thrives in a fast\-paced environment, and wants to gain hands\-on experience promoting brands at live events and activations.

Please note: This is a full\-time, on\-site position. Candidates must be able to commute to our Chicago location daily. Remote work is not available.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the delivery of engaging marketing campaigns at events, pop\-ups, and retail locations
* Interact with customers in a professional and approachable way to build brand awareness
* Share product knowledge and answer customer questions confidently
* Assist with event setup, coordination, and execution alongside the team
* Monitor individual performance and contribute to team targets and campaign success

**What We Offer**

* Weekly earnings with performance incentives — typical OTE ranges from $750–$1,350\+ per week
* Additional bonuses, team incentives, and recognition programs
* Structured training designed to build your marketing and communication skills
* Opportunities for career progression into team leadership and management roles
* A supportive, team\-oriented culture with ongoing mentorship
* The chance to work across different event locations and campaigns

On top of this we offer access to a company\-supported wellness program, with gym membership discounts and resources that support your physical performance and day\-to\-day energy!

**About You**

* Friendly, confident, and comfortable engaging with new people
* Self\-motivated and driven to achieve personal and team goals
* Reliable, proactive, and eager to learn
* Interested in developing a long\-term career in marketing, events, or sales

**Experience**  
No previous experience is required. We provide full training, making this an excellent opportunity for recent graduates or anyone looking to transition into marketing and events.

**Why Join Evolve?**  
At Evolve, we focus on developing talent from the ground up. You’ll gain practical experience, build valuable skills, and be part of a growing team that values ambition, performance, and progression.

Apply now to start your journey in event marketing with Evolv in Chicago!

* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
